items.text: Please prepare the deployment checklist before the planning meeting. Include the backup status, the test results, the rollback instructions, and the person responsible for each check. I will review the checklist after lunch and send my comments to the team. Keep the existing maintenance window until everyone confirms that the new timing works for their customers. If a check fails, leave the service on the current version and record the failure in the release notes. We need the full record so the next engineer can understand what happened without repeating the investigation or guessing which step was completed.
